questions.text: Suppose that we apply Dropout regularization to a feed forward neural network. Suppose further that mini-batch gradient descent algorithm is used for updating the parameters of the network. Choose the correct statement from the following:
options: This will lead to sparcity in the trained weights.
The dropout probability [IMAGE: /data/images/cs3004_2026T1_Q2_NA_p1_Im3.webp|inline] can be different for each hidden layer.

The weights of the neurons which were dropped during the forward propagation at [IMAGE: /data/images/cs3004_2026T1_Q2_NA_p1_Im4.webp|inline] -th iteration will not get updated during [IMAGE: /data/images/cs3004_2026T1_Q2_NA_p1_Im5.webp|inline] -th iteration.

Consider training a deep neural network for a multi-class classification problem. The output layer uses softmax activation, and the hidden layers use ReLU as an activation function. After a few training iterations, you observe that the weights in the initial hidden layers barely get updated. Which of the following actions could help tackle this issue?
options: Replace ReLU with Leaky ReLU in the hidden layers.
Replace ReLU by tanh in the hidden layers.
Increasing the number of neurons in the output layer.
Increasing the learning rate.
correct_answer: Replace ReLU with Leaky ReLU in the hidden layers.
